source_row.rationale: Wound evisceration is a surgical emergency. Priority actions include covering the wound and protruding organs with a sterile saline-soaked dressing (never attempting to push organs back in), positioning the client to reduce abdominal tension (often low Fowler's with knees bent), keeping the client NPO in anticipation of emergency surgery, and notifying the surgeon immediately.
source_row.source_detail: Emergency management: cover eviscerated organs with sterile saline-moistened dressings, reduce abdominal strain, keep NPO and notify surgical team; accessed 2026-08-14.
